subject: Renewal & Expansion: Roadmap showcase — attendee lanes + backup hosts
messages:
From: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated renewal + expansion walkthrough

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for walking us through the initial renewal terms last week. As we discussed offline, we'd like to combine the renewal QBR and the expansion roadmap walkthrough into a single session for our execs and product leads. Goal is to keep it tight so leadership can attend: roughly 45–60 minutes.

Attendees from our side: Claire (CPO), myself (VP Product), and our CTO (Samir Patel). Procurement may join for the first 10–15 minutes to confirm commercial points.

Could you propose a concise agenda and 2–3 time options next week? Also:
- We prefer a single recording for internal distribution.
- Would like an option for a short technical breakout with an infra/ops owner present.

Thanks — if easier, loop in the folks who will own the exec intro and the deep-dive.

Best,
Peter
Peter Lowe
VP, Product 
Clearline Health

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@clearlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal + expansion walkthrough

Hi Peter —

Appreciate the clarity — we can absolutely compress this into a single, action-oriented session. Suggested compact format (45 minutes):

  - 5m: Welcome + objectives (Marissa — exec framing & renewal headline)
  - 20m: Product roadmap highlights + roadmap ask (Hannah)
  - 15m: Technical deep-dive + migration/ops implications (Rishi)
  - 5m: Next steps & commitments (Marissa/Hannah)

We can optionally open a short breakout after the session for a 20-minute technical Q&A with your infra team; otherwise we capture detailed follow-ups in a shared doc.

Proposed time windows (PT):
  1) Tue 6/15 10:00–10:45
  2) Wed 6/16 13:00–13:45
  3) Thu 6/17 08:30–09:15

I've attached a draft agenda (clearline_roadmap_agenda_v2.pdf) and our demo playbook that lists who can host each lane (redwood-demo-playbook.odt). Marissa will lead the exec intro and renewal close; Rishi will own the deep-dive and the breakout if you want one. Naomi is listed as backup for Rishi if there are calendar conflicts.

If one of the slots works, I'll send a calendar invite with the recording enabled and include a short pre-read. Any constraints on the CTO joining live vs watching the recording?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal + expansion walkthrough

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 10:03 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I've attached a draft agenda (clearline_roadmap_agenda_v2.pdf) and our demo playbook that lists who can host each lane (redwood-demo-playbook.odt).
> Marissa will lead the exec intro and renewal close; Rishi will own the deep-dive and the breakout if you want one. Naomi is listed as backup for Rishi if there are calendar conflicts.

I'll take the exec intro and the renewal ask — short and to the point.

Notes:
- I'll open with the renewal headline (5m) and then hand to Hannah for roadmap highlights.
- Rishi — please flag any blockers you think we should pre-empt (scaling, private deployment, or data residency asks) so we can add them to the pre-read.
- Naomi: be on standby to host the deep-dive if Rishi needs to join a conflicting call.

I'll also add a single-slide summary on the commercial terms to the agenda PDF and share the updated file before you send the invite.

Marissa Cole
Director, Account Strategy | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@clearlinehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal + expansion walkthrough — confirmed 6/16 13:00 PT

Thanks — Wed 6/16 13:00–13:45 PT works for Claire and me; Samir (CTO) will try to join but may watch the recording. Recording is fine.

Please include the breakout option for a 20-minute technical session immediately after (we'll confirm attendance from infra closer to the date). Also can you attach the final one-slide commercial summary for our procurement attendees? Proc will join first 10–15 minutes.

We've added a placeholder in our calendar and I'll accept once I get the invite from you. Also sending over a short DocuSign link for the renewal amendment separately via procurement (expect that tomorrow).

Appreciate the coordination.

—Peter
